items.title: Dr. Di Zhu selected as the Academic Director of AAG Geographic Information Science & Systems Specialty Group (GISS-SG)
items.description: On September 18, 2026, AAG Geographic Information Science and Systems Specialty Group (GISS-SG) announced its newly elected Board of Directors (BOD).

items.title: GeoDI Lab members attended the 2026 CaGIS conference
items.description: Professor Di Zhu and Meicheng attended the 2026 CaGIS conference The Cartographer in the Loop held in St Louis from Sep 8 to Sep 11, 2026.

items.title: Zhongfu Ma Awarded Doctoral Dissertation Fellowship from University of Minnesota
items.description: We are delighted to share that Zhongfu Ma has been awarded the Doctoral Dissertation Fellowship from the University of Minnesota College of Liberal Arts.
